witness.branch: Forward road travel with a speed-limit sign
witness.quote: Backup lamps shall not be lighted when the vehicle is in forward motion.
witness.reason: Road travel can include actual forward motion by a motor vehicle equipped with backup lamps. The speed-limit sign neither activates nor excludes this equipment prohibition.
required_context: Construct actual forward travel and obtain synchronized oriented-motion and actual lamp-illumination observations.
Establish a self-propelled, nonrail motor vehicle capable of transporting persons or property on a highway, outside the supplied excluded device classes.
Establish self-propelled, nonrail motor-vehicle status and applicable vehicle exclusions, retaining the unresolved incorporated NRS 482.029 reference.
Establish sign placement, posted instruction, authority and governed road portion relative to the ego route; no posted value or legal cutoff is supplied here.
Identify installed backup lamps and separate or combined installation; installation is optional under the supplied subsection.
Identify installed backup lamps and whether their installation is separate or combined with other lamps.
Preserve the absence of a supplied numerical motion threshold, minimum duration or reverse-to-forward overlap allowance.
Record synchronized actual lamp illumination, velocity, heading and speed; do not derive forward motion solely from gear.
Specify the sign's placement, posted instruction, authority and governed road portion as scene context without treating it as an activation condition.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor_vehicle_driver operates the qualifying motor vehicle whose backup lamps are regulated; the operative text regulates vehicle equipment rather than expressly assigning a driver duty.

targeted_requirements.quote: Backup lamps shall not be lighted when the vehicle is in forward motion.
targeted_requirements.rationale: Observe actual illumination throughout actual forward motion without deriving motion direction from gear.
